seoTitle: Add ads.txt to a Squarespace Site for AdSense
metaDescription: Learn two ways to add an ads.txt file to Squarespace for Google AdSense, even on the free plan, using file uploads or GitHub hosting.
intro: Google AdSense requires an ads.txt file at your domain's root, which is tricky on Squarespace's free plan since it doesn't allow direct root access. This guide covers two methods: uploading the file as a link with a URL mapping, and hosting it on GitHub as a more reliable alternative.

steps.heading: Create your ads.txt file
steps.body: Open a text editor, paste the code provided by Google AdSense with your publisher ID, and save the file as ads.txt.

steps.heading: Upload the file in Squarespace
steps.body: Go to Pages, add a new Link, choose the File option, and upload your ads.txt file, then copy the resulting file link.

steps.heading: Map the URL to your root domain
steps.body: Go to Settings, then Advanced, then URL Mappings, and add a redirect from /ads.txt to your uploaded file link.

steps.heading: Test the setup
steps.body: Open yourdomain.com/ads.txt in a private browser window to confirm the file loads correctly.

steps.heading: Use GitHub if the static method fails
steps.body: If the redirect doesn't work, create a free GitHub repository, upload your ads.txt file, and copy the raw file URL.

steps.heading: Redirect to the GitHub-hosted file
steps.body: Add the same URL mapping in Squarespace, pointing /ads.txt to the raw GitHub URL, so AdSense can access it publicly.

faq.question: Can I add ads.txt on Squarespace's free plan?
faq.answer: Yes, you can upload the file as a downloadable link and use a URL mapping redirect, even on the free plan.

faq.question: What if the static Squarespace method doesn't work?
faq.answer: Hosting the ads.txt file on GitHub and redirecting to its raw URL is a more reliable alternative.

faq.question: How do I test if my ads.txt file is working?
faq.answer: Open yourdomain.com/ads.txt in a private or incognito browser window to check whether the content loads.

faq.question: Where do I set up the URL mapping in Squarespace?
faq.answer: URL mappings are configured under Settings, then Advanced, then URL Mappings.

faq.question: Is the GitHub method free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, creating a public GitHub repository to host your ads.txt file is free.
